articles.text: ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Sàimǔsī Xiānsheng, nín yàode shíjiānbiǎo.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Mr. Simms, the schedule you asked for.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Ou, xièxie, xièxie. Yǒu Zhōngguó zì, yǒu pīnyīn, hǎojíle. Nǐmende gōngzuò sùdù bǐ yǐqián kuàiduō le.
MR. SIMMS: Thank you, thank you. It has Chinese characters and Pinyin — that's great. You people are much faster on the job than you used to be.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Lǚxíngshède gōngzuò yě děi xiàndàihuà ma! Duì le, wǒ gāngcái jìnlaide shíhou, nín hǎoxiàng zài zhǎo shénme. Wǒ yěxǔ kěyi bāng nín zhǎoyizhǎo?
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: The Travel Service has to modernize its work too, after all! Oh yes — just now when I came in, you seemed to be looking for something. Perhaps I could help you?
SÀIMǓSĪ: Nǐ kàn, Dàqìng bú shi zài Hēilóngjiāng ma? Wǒ zěnme zhǎole bàntiān méi zhǎodào ne?
MR. SIMMS: Look. Isn't Dàqìng in Hēilóngjiāng? How come I've been looking for it for so long and haven't found it?
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Ou, nín zài biānjìngshang zhǎo dāngrán zhǎobudào le. Dàqìng zài Hēilóngjiāngde zhōngxīn, zài zhèr ne!
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Oh, of course you won't find it if you look near the border. Dàqìng is in the center of Hēilóngjiāng. Here it is!
SÀIMǓSĪ: Ou! Zài zhèr. Zài liùshí niándài, qīshí niándài, zhèr shi yíge bǐjiào tèbiéde jīngjì dìqū.
MR. SIMMS: Oh, here it is. In the sixties and seventies this was a rather special economic region.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Nín shuōde duì. Zhèige dìfang jīngguòle chàbuduō èrshiniánde jiànshè, fāzhǎnchéngle yíge yǒu qīshiwàn rénkǒude gōngyè chéngshì. Bāshí niándài chū yòu chénglìle Dàqìng Shì Rénmín Zhèngfǔ.

ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: That's right. It went through about twenty years of construction to develop into an industrial city of 700,000. Then in the early eighties they established the People's Government of the City of Dàqìng.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Zài shì zhèngfǔde lǐngdǎoxia, Dàqìngde jiànshè sùdù dàgài gèng kuài le. Zuìjìn qítāde gōngyè yǒu méiyou shénme xīnde fāzhǎn?
MR. SIMMS: Under the leadership of the city government, Dàqìng is probably being built even faster. Has there also been growth in other industries recently?
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Fāzhǎn bǐjiào kuàide yào suàn méitàn gōngyè hé jīxiè gōngyè le.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: The coal industry and the machine industry would have to be counted among the more rapidly developing.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Méitàn shēngchǎn zài Zhōngguóde zhòng gōngyèli zhàn hěn zhòngyàode dìwèi. Dōngběi yìzhí shi méitàn chǎnliàng hěn gāode dìqū.
MR. SIMMS: Coal production has a very important place in China's heavy industry. Manchuria has always had a very high coal output.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Duì, Dōngběi méitàn zīyuán bù shǎo, shi zhòngyàode kuàngqū. Sàimǔsī Xiānsheng, nín yìzhí hěn guānxīn wǒmende jīngjì jiànshè a!
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Yes, Manchuria has very large coal reserves. It's an important mining region. You've always been concerned about our economic construction, Mr. Simms!
SÀIMǓSĪ: Shì a, wǒ shi gōngchéngshī, wǒ yìzhí fēicháng zhùyì Zhōngguó jīngjì jiànshède biànhuà, wǒ xīwàng Zhōngguó kuài yìdiǎnr jiànshèchéng yíge gōngyèhuàde guójiā.
MR. SIMMS: Yes. I'm an engineer, and I've always paid attention to the changes in China's economic construction. I hope China will be built into an industrialized country very soon.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Xièxie nín. Xiànzài yǒu hěn duō wàiguó péngyou guānxīn wǒmende jiànshè, wǒmen shi fēicháng gǎnxiède. Zhōngguó hái shi yíge hěn qióngde guójiā, xūyào shìjiè gèguó zhuānjiāmende bāngzhù.

ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Thank you. A lot of foreign friends are concerned about our construction now, and we're very grateful for it. China is still a poor country. We need help from experts of every country in the world.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Nín tài kèqi le, nǐmen gèfāngmiànde fāzhǎn sùdù hái shi xiāngdāng kuàide. Érqiě, zhòngdiǎn fāzhǎnde dìqū yě bù shǎo, wǒ xiǎng, nǐmen yào zhòngdiǎn fāzhǎnde gōngyèqū qǐmǎ yǒu shíge.

MR. SIMMS: You're too polite. You're still developing quite rapidly in all areas. And furthermore, you have quite a few key development regions. I believe there are at least ten industrial regions on which you are focusing development.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Shì, yǒu shíge.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Yes, there are ten.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Chúle Běijīng, Tiānjīn, Shànghǎi, Dàqìng yǐwài, Nèiměng, Shǎnxī, Sìchuān, zhèixiē dìfang zài zuìjìn shíniánli dōu huì yǒu hěn dàde biànhuà, duì bu duì?
MR. SIMMS: Besides Běijīng, Tiānjīn, Shànghǎi, and Dàqìng, Inner Mongolia, Shǎnxī and Sìchuān will all experience great changes in the next ten years, don't you think?
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Nín bié wàngle, wǒmende yánhǎi yídài, zuìjìn jǐnián jìnbù hěn kuài ou! Tèbié shi Guǎngdōng.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Don't forget that our coastal regions have made rapid progress in the last few years, especially Guǎngdōng.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Guǎngdōngde qīng gōngyè yìzhí shi bú huàide.
MR. SIMMS: Guǎngdōng's light industry has always been pretty good.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Zuìjìn, nàrde shíyóu gōngyè yě gǎode xiāngdāng bú cuò, nín méiyou tīngshuō ma?
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Recently, their petroleum industry has been doing rather well — haven't you heard?
SÀIMǓSĪ: Tīngshuō le. Wǒ zěnme huì wàngle Zhōngguó hǎiwānde shíyóu ne? Hái yǒu, Yúnnánde tèdiǎn shi shénme ne?
MR. SIMMS: Oh, of course. How could I forget China's gulf oil? And what is the distinguishing feature of Yúnnán?
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Shi jīnshǔ gōngyè.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: The metal industry.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Nǐ kànkan, Zhōngguóde qíngkuàng bú cuò ma! Nánfāngde jīnshǔ gōngyè fāzhǎnde gèng kuài le.
MR. SIMMS: Look, China's situation is pretty good! The metal industry of the south is developing even more quickly.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Zhèi shi zhēnde. Suīrán wǒmen xiànzàide jìshu lìliang hái hěn ruò, kěshi wǒmen yídìng děi nǔlì jiākuài fāzhǎnde sùdù.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: That's true. Although our technical capability is still weak, we must work hard to speed our development.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Méi wèntí, jǐshínián yǐhòude Zhōngguó yídìng kěyi biànchéng yíge jīngjì qiángguó.
MR. SIMMS: That's no problem. In a few decades I'm sure China will become an economic power.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Xièxie nín, búguò yěxǔ xūyào gèng cháng yìdiǎnrde shíjiān.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Thank you, but perhaps it will take more time than that.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Zhèi bù yídìng, yěxǔ bú yào tài chángde shíjiān. Bǐfang shuō shíyóu ba! Yī jiǔ wǔ líng nián, nǐmende shíyóu chǎnliàng zài shìjièshang zhàn dìèrshijiǔwèi, xiànzài ne, xiànzài shi dìbāwèi la!
MR. SIMMS: Not necessarily, maybe it won't be too long. Oil, for example. In 1950 you were twenty-ninth in the world in oil production, and now — now you're in eighth place!
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Shíyóu gōngyè tèbié yìdiǎnr, zǒngde lái shuō, wǒmen hái yǒu bù shǎo wèntí, zài xǔduō fāngmiàn wǒmen hái děi xué.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: The oil industry is a little special. Generally speaking, we still have a lot of problems. We still have to learn in a lot of areas.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Bú yào kèqi, bù guǎn shi shénme jìshu wèntí, rúguǒ shi wǒ kěyi bāng mángde jiù qǐng gàosu wo.
MR. SIMMS: Don't be polite. No matter what the technical problem, if it's something I can help with, please let me know.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Tài xièxie nín le. Shàngcì nín bú shi shuō xiǎng duō cānguān jǐge gōngyèqū ma?
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Thank you so much. Remember you said last time that you would like to visit more industrial regions?
SÀIMǓSĪ: Shì a, yǒu méiyou kěnéng?
MR. SIMMS: Right. Does it look possible?
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Yǒu, lǐngdǎo zhèng zài ānpái. Nín fàng xīn ba!
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Yes, my superiors are arranging it right now. Don't worry!
SÀIMǓSĪ: Tài xièxie nǐmen le.
MR. SIMMS: Thank you so much.
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒmen zhǔnbèi shàng chē ba!
ZHŪ WÉNYÙ: It's almost time. Let's get ready to board the train.
SÀIMǓSĪ: Hǎo, zǒu!
MR. SIMMS: All right, let's go!
